name: Boots of the Winterlands
description: Fur-lined boots that leave no prints in snow.
body:
## What they do

The cold cannot bite you in them. Ice and snow are no harder to cross than open ground, and you are comfortable in cold as deep as fifty below.

features.name: Winter Walk
features.text: Ice and snow are not difficult terrain for you, and you can bear cold as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit without protection.
